scope: Kernel-checked statements: Newton parity interpolation and its off-window defect (closed form and bound); Boolean-lattice Mobius inversion and the Boolean-differences identity of Lemma 3.3 (Mobius-coefficient form); the measurement-separation identity of Lemma 3.2 (algebraic core); uniqueness of Hermite interpolation; the isoperimetric rank barrier for any auxiliary pair (M0, C) with the Hamming support condition, including its threshold form; the R-subcube obstruction for point-dependent cube designs; the independent-set to 2-CNF counting bijection (all sizes and fixed size). Translations between these statements and the preprint, and binomial-tail estimates, are informal; see problems/eth/subresults. Added 2026-10-29: the rank barrier for arbitrary point-dependent designs (SR-03), global formulas, low Fourier degree of symmetric polynomials and the slab construction with its 1/R bound (SR-04), soundness of stress certificates and products of designs (SR-05), and the graded-counting identities (SR-07).
